summary.text: John Andrews is the Republican candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
He previously served in the Maine House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: John Andrews lives in Paris, Maine, and earned a B.A. from the University of New Hampshire in 2001.
He has served as vice president of Waterford Fish and Game, vice-chair of the Paris Select Board and chair of the Paris Economic Development Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Andrews as a member of the Maine House of Representatives from 2018 to 2024, most recently representing District 79.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Elections Committee as Ranking Member, the Judiciary Committee and the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee.
On December 14, 2020, he announced he was leaving the Republican Party to join the Libertarian Party of Maine, and on December 30, 2021, he announced he would register again as a Republican.
He resigned from the House on June 12, 2024.
